_about: Hand labels for every POISON-* finding in the 2026-10-29 top-100 npm re-measure (docs/research/2026-10-29-top100-npm/summary.json). scripts/bench_poisoning.py precision refuses to run unless these labels cover every finding exactly once. Method: docs/poisoning.md#how-the-top-100-findings-were-labelled. The 2026-10-22 labels (mcp-audit 0.21.0, 661 findings) are kept in top100-labels-2026-10-22.json.
labelled_patterns_fingerprint_note: scripts/bench_poisoning.py patterns_fingerprint() of analyzers/poisoning.py and build_runtime_server_config at main 91120b0, the code that produced these 46 findings.

label_definitions.true_positive: The text the finding points at is an attempt to make the agent do something the user did not ask for, or to hide content from the user.
label_definitions.false_positive: The text is ordinary documentation of the tool or its parameters.

basis_definitions.review: Each finding was read in its full live tool definition on 2026-10-29 (definitions not committed; scripts/enumerate_isolated.py regenerates them). For POISON-050, every description of 2,000 characters or more was also searched for instruction-like phrases (ignore previous, do not tell, without asking, secret, exfiltrate, curl, ~/.ssh, .env, system prompt, hidden, silently); each hit was documentation (a deduplication note, a search example listing '.env', a 'do not ask the user for the plaintext password' safety note).
